bookingOpens: Online through the booking page on the restaurant's website (prenota-web), for up to 6 people; booking calls and messages are handled Monday to Friday, 9am–1pm and 2–6pm.
cancellation: Bookings can be cancelled up to 12 hours ahead, through the link in the confirmation email or by phone.
waitlist: When no table is free, a waiting-list form can be filled in; the restaurant calls if a table comes free. Being on the list is not a booking.
groups: Groups of more than 6 book by phone and choose one of the tasting menus on the day.
dressCode: No dress code; informal or smart casual clothes are suggested.
children: Children of any age are welcome, as long as other guests' peace is respected.
